name: creatorhub-ai
description: CreatorHub AI — AI-native content creator marketplace

scripts.setup: node scripts/ensure-postgres.mjs && prisma generate && prisma db push && tsx prisma/seed.ts
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.db:reset: prisma db push --force-reset && npm run db:seed
